Welcome to Physical Therapy First's new YouTube Page! Make sure you check us out weekly for the latest PTFtip video series.  Here is where you can watch our Physical Therapist give you their favorite tricks and tips to enhance your recovery process!  We will make videos on everything from doing simple exercises correctly to therapy techniques we use on a day to day basis with our patients.
Like us on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/PhysicalTherapyFirst/ and make sure to check out our Instagram for daily updates @physicaltherapyfirstllc
